Name: Slime Livestock And Horse
Author: popando
Description:
[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]

 This mod makes all of your livestock and your horse into a blueish green colour to fit with all your pet slimes. This includes rabbits, goats, pigs, ducks, dinosaurs, sheep, all chickens, both cows, horses and all baby variants of animals listed above.

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

Just extract the .zip file and place the folder in your Stardew Valley Mods Folder. This mod requires SMAPI and Content Patcher to be installed. Because this mod used Content Patcher, you do not have to replace the XNB files inside the game.

[size=5][b]Plans[/b][/size]

Feel free to post and suggest features I should add, heres the current list :
[list]
[*]Make other colours of slime available
[*]Give the animals antenna 
[*]Make the animal items (dinosaur egg, wool, rabbits foot etc.) slimy
[*]Make the animal buildings (coop, barn, silo, slime hutch) slimy
[*]Make all buildings slimy
[/list][size=5][b]Other Mods
[/b][/size]
I have another mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4311]Here[/url] that makes the cat and dog slime-tastic which pairs well with this mod.
